messages:
Leah (Support): Customer reports several requests with valid request IDs in their app logs but the Trace View shows no spans/links for those request IDs since ~2026-03-15 22:10 UTC. A production job is affected in us-east. Escalating to SRE/ingest.
Ravi (SRE): Is this the same tenant we saw last week? Any recent deploys to the ingress/proxy around that time?
Leah (Support): Yes, tenant acme-payments-prod. They noted an ingress config change deployed ~22:07-22:09 UTC. Customer provided a quick repro they ran locally:
```
curl -v -H "x-request-id: abc-123-test" https://api.redwood.example.com/checkout/charge
```
They see the header in their app logs but nothing appears in our trace panel for abc-123-test.
Eli (Eng): Can you paste a short sample of the app log + our ingress/ingest logs showing the request? Also what's the current trace sampling rate for this tenant?
Leah (Support): Sample app log (from customer):
```
2026-03-15T22:10:05.123Z app[web.1]: INFO request received path=/checkout/charge x-request-id=abc-123-test status=200
```
Our ingress log (same time, forwarded):
```
2026-03-15T22:10:05.128Z ingress[host-a]: INFO conn from 10.4.x.x path=/checkout/charge x-request-id=- forwarded-headers="x-trace-id: 7f9" route=payments
```
Note: ingress shows x-request-id as "-" while it preserved x-trace-id.
ingest-bot: Ingest deploy event: frontend-header-whitelist v2.3 deployed 2026-03-15T22:07:42Z; whitelist now only allows ["x-trace-id","x-span-id"], dropped other custom headers. (automated)
Ravi (SRE): That looks like header mangling. Hypothesis: the Envoy/header filter rollout removed x-request-id from the forwarded whitelist, so our stitcher can't link request IDs to traces because the canonical key changed. Quick check: from an internal shell run:
```
curl -s -D - -H "x-request-id: test-req-42" https://ingress-canary.us-east.redwood/internal/echo | grep -i x-request-id || true
```
Eli (Eng): If the canary reproduces, mitigation options:
- Short term: update ingestion to accept fallback headers (x-trace-id or generated header) so stitcher can use alternate keys.
- Hotfix: revert header-whitelist change on canary hosts in us-east.
- Backfill: attempt to re-link missing traces by joining on timestamp + path + customer-id for last 1h (expensive, may impact billing).
I'll open a hotfix PR and a backfill playbook.
Leah (Support): Customer asked for ETA. Can we do fast mitigation + then plan backfill? Also need to add a billing note if we do heavy backfill.
Ravi (SRE): @Eli please take lead. I'll rollback the whitelist change on canaries in us-east now and monitor.
Eli (Eng): Opened PR #2384: hotfix to accept x-request-id fallback and revert whitelist on canary (desc in PR). Deploying to canary in ~10m, will post results. Repro & logs attached to PR.
Leah (Support): Thanks — I'll let the customer know we have a canary rollback and will follow up after canary validation. Collecting example request IDs from customer and adding to ticket.
Ravi (SRE): (reaction :eyes:) Monitoring ingress metrics, will report within 15m.
Leah (Support): Leaving thread open for updates."
